ops.note:
Verified against released ccx v0.39.0 in a scratch `--depth 1` clone of `octocat/Hello-World` — genuinely non-personal: `ccx vcs info` reports `name_with_owner: octocat/Hello-World`, `viewer_login: yasyf`, `viewer_permission: READ`. Run on trunk (`master`), with no flags beyond `--no-push`.

```
$ git rev-parse master                 # 7fd1a60b01f91b314f59955a4e4d4e80d8edf11d
$ ccx vcs ship --no-push -m "feat: t4 branch before commit"
committed b57cf37 "feat: t4 branch before commit" · created feat-t4-branch-before-commit · not pushed
$ git branch --show-current            # feat-t4-branch-before-commit
$ git rev-parse master                 # 7fd1a60b01f91b314f59955a4e4d4e80d8edf11d  (unmoved)
```

The branch was created *before* the commit, not after: trunk never moved, and the commit exists only on the new branch. Had the order been reversed, `master` would point at `b57cf37`. Branch name follows ccx's convention decided for this epic — `feat-t4-branch-before-commit`, hyphens, no date prefix.

A real non-personal repo was used rather than `Forge-AI/monorepo` so nothing touches a shared working repo; `--no-push` means nothing left the machine.
